title: Example Website
text:
This is a Quarto website.
To learn more about Quarto websites visit https://quarto.org/docs/websites.
Start by choosing a theme and setting it in _quarto.yml:
format:
  html:
    theme: <set it here>
And then setting a layout here in this page’s YAML block:
about:
  template: <set it here>
Add more pages by making more .qmd files in the root folder and then linking to them in your text or adding them to the navbar in _quarto.yml:
website:
  title: "Example Website"
  navbar:
    left:
      - href: index.qmd
        text: Home
      - about.qmd
Now you can keep changing the YAML blocks for more customization! Here are some more things you can add:

A main site image:

image: <path to image>
image-alt: "<text describing your image>"

Fancy links to your social media/Google Scholar/etc:

about:
  links:
    - text:
      icon:
      url:

Bibliography

bibliography: <path to a .bib file>
Whatever you in-text cite using the @<code for a given citation source> will then automatically be added to that pages bibliography
Then add the following where you want your bibliography to appear:
# References

How did I set this up?

Created a new folder
Ran this in the command line quarto create project website and followed the prompts
Made the publish.yml file which should be copy/pasted directly
Published the repo to Github
In Github, added a “gh-pages” branch
Went to “Settings > Pages” to get my URL

Then I had a website!
